2.q: Trace the correct sequence of requirements that decided whether a region could adopt the High Yielding Variety package.
2.a: The adoption chain runs: (1) HYV seeds demand assured water, fertiliser and pesticide together (2) Irrigated northwestern districts could fund the package through institutional credit (3) Rainfed eastern regions lacked canals, tubewells and loan access (4) Productivity and income gaps between the regions widened as a result. A wrong answer that blames farmer laziness or soil poverty shows the student has confused agro-climatic constraint with institutional and infrastructural failure.
